messages:
emma: Heads-up — postmortem watchlist for last week's GPU surge. Putting a compact set of follow-ups here so we can rotate owners and close items before Q2 planning.

kai: thanks. quick summary for context: surge started 2026-02-18 03:12 UTC, scheduler flapped under a burst of long-seq requests, quota backfills didn't trigger in time, headroom dropped to 3% for ~27m.

liam: adding one note — we saw repeated autoscale oscillations during the 10–30s window after deploys. looks like hysteresis settings + small bursts are the root cause for the oscillation pattern.

anika: agreed. i sketched a short remediation plan offline. TL;DR: adjust scheduler soft-quota, add a short post-deploy cooldown, and run a staged headroom soak test.

emma: concrete actions I want here:
- A1: Scheduler soft-quota tuning and guardrails (owner: @kai) — propose new soft-quota algorithm param values, run bench, PR to scheduler config by 2026-03-03.
- A2: Autoscale cooldown (owner: @liam) — implement 45s cooldown after scale events and test in preprod by 2026-03-05.
- A3: Headroom watchlist + alert refinement (owner: @anika) — create a short alert that triggers at <10% headroom for >5m with runbook link, due 2026-03-02.
- A4: Quota backstop policy (owner: @emma) — define emergency quota backfill policy + AML approval, due 2026-03-10.

kai: taking A1. plan: bump soft-quota threshold from 0.95->0.9 and add a weighted moving-average over 60s to reduce sensitivity. I'll run a k8s scheduler sim with the burst trace and share numbers.

liam: will handle A2. quick note: cooldown needs to be safe for rapid traffic ramps for PLG customers — i'll add a conditional bypass if target qps > X. will test with synthetic bursts.

anika: A3 accepted. i'll add the alert to the console dashboard and wire it to the oncall rotation channel. also adding a severity tag and a one-click runbook that contains the mitigation steps (scale, fallback to smaller model variant, throttle long-seq routes).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New ticket created: SCHED-472 (Scheduler soft-quota tuning) assigned to kai.

emma: for A4 i'll draft the policy and circulate it to legal/compliance. emergency backfills will be gated to Dedicated customers only initially.

kai: early sim numbers look promising — moving average removes oscillation in 3/4 traces. sharing CSV in #eng-ml in a bit.

liam: flag: the cooldown may increase tail latency for single-request bursts. i'll add a test for p99 under mixed traffic.

anika: small ask — can we add a recurring postmortem digest that surfaces recurring incident patterns every 2 weeks? we keep re-rediscovering the same oscillation pattern.

emma: +1. that digest would help reduce duplicate work. propose a lightweight watchlist: patterns, owners, last action, next review date. I'll draft the template.

kai: suggest we also add a periodic capacity burn test in preprod: 1h synthetic long-seq flood at 1.2x peak to validate headroom and autoscale. owner: eng-runtime. cadence: monthly.

liam: noted. adding test matrix to SCHED-473 (autoscale cooldown qa).

anika: i've created the alert PR and linked the runbook. PR: #2981. please review.

emma: next steps: owners to update their ticket with a short acceptance criteria + rollback plan by next checkpoint 2026-02-28 EOD. i'll run a 15m sync on 2026-03-01 to confirm closures.

liam: putting acceptance criteria in SCHED-473 now.

kai: SCHED-472 updated with sim results + proposed config.

anika: PR merged to add alert to staging.

emma: great. once A1–A3 are validated in staging, we'll schedule a limited prod rollout with a canary of 10% traffic and close the watchlist item if no regressions after 48h.

ops-bot: reminder: oncall rotation starts 2026-03-01 — watchlist owners please coordinate with oncall for the rollout window.

liam: noted, coordinating with ops.

kai: thanks everyone. i'll share the final tuning numbers in #eng-runtime tomorrow.

emma: thanks — i'll convert this thread into a short doc and add it to the postmortem action tracker. if anyone wants to be unassigned from an action ping me here. :thumbsup:
